Oe.bar_b_note: The mossy hare is a believable naturalistic model, but on a grey stage with a flat blue swim slab (A) or a creature levitating far above its shadow (B) there is no world light or atmosphere to put it beside Palworld.

At.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing elder with a Meadows palette, but the smooth plastic, big-eyed animated-film look clashes with the naturalistic creature bar and stylised-realism key art, and there is no lit scene.

Ll.bar_b_note: The large mossy turtle has good scale and surface, but the floating carry pose (A) and the flat blue swim slab with a blown white edge (B) on a neutral stage sink the finish.

Ij.bar_b_note: Blurry smeared ground textures, flat box-like cave walls, lollipop trees, flat noon light and no fog or atmosphere read as a prototype rather than a Palworld-class lived-in world, although B's aftermath storytelling helps.

Qv.bar_b_note: B's glowing lightning-veined wolf is close to the owner's Tanglevolt bar, but on a neutral stage with no Valheim-class light, and A's floating faint frames with a mottled white material break it.

Od.bar_b_note: The grass, sky and mountains get close to the Meadows palette, but flat lighting, a backdrop-like mountain range, a low-detail pale boulder and B's glowing white card wall keep it short of the Palworld finish.

Bw.bar_b_note: The same mossy hare reads well on its own, but the flat swim slab (A) and the levitating carry frame (B) on a grey stage give no world light or grounding to match Palworld.

Wz.bar_b_note: The turtle model has the right scale and naturalistic shell, but the flat swim slab (A) and the floating carry pose (B) on a neutral stage keep it at test-render finish.

top_changes.change: Ground the travel-role frames: replace the flat blue swim slab with its blown white edge with a real water surface (waterline, ripples, submerged tint), and put carrying creatures on the ground with a contact shadow instead of hovering

Raise the Meadows world finish in the trainer-site and homestead views: sharper ground and path materials, broken-up vegetation into groves and clearings, warm directional light with aerial perspective and blue distance fog, and replace the flat cave walls and backdrop mountains with modelled forms
Rebuild the villager character in the naturalistic stylised-realism style of the creature bar (real skin and cloth materials, less animated-film eyes and proportions)
